LQG_SPINFOAM.result: The source-defined gamma-simple hypergeometric Toller branches were independently reproduced over gamma in {0.1,0.5,1,2,5} and j in {1/2,1,3/2,2,3}; t+ + t- returned the Lorentzian Wigner d element to sub-1e-9 relative residual and the published large-beta absolute decay exponent was reproduced to about 1e-3 worst-case slope error.
LQG_SPINFOAM.scope: This materially strengthens the causal-sector building block but does not establish absolute convergence, finiteness or normalization of the full causal spinfoam vertex.

CAUSAL_FERMION_SYSTEMS.result: A fail-closed bounded-coefficient envelope for the entire delta^3+ correction hierarchy was audited over delta/L in {0.1,0.03,0.01,0.003,0.001} and assumed coefficient bounds B in {1,10,100}; the geometric-envelope arithmetic is internally consistent to machine precision.
CAUSAL_FERMION_SYSTEMS.scope: B is an explicit assumption scan, not a source fit or CFS prediction. The missing scientific object remains the explicit source-defined delta^3+ correction tensor and coefficients.

ASYMPTOTIC_SAFETY.result: The Lorentzian graviton spectral UV tail proportional to 1/[lambda^2 log^3(lambda^2)] was independently integrated under the source KL measure from Lambda=5 through 1e24 and matched the analytic normalized tail 1/[4 pi log^2(Lambda^2)] to below 1e-9 relative error.
ASYMPTOTIC_SAFETY.scope: This is a spectral normalisability/scaling certificate with c_h^UV normalized to one, not an extraction of the physical coefficient and not a same-realization composition with the ERG2026 contact-complete scattering amplitude.
